knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The walk-round is a daily pre-use check covering the machine, the basket, the controls, the ground and the overhead hazards.
Appearance is not confirmation. A line stays live until it is confirmed as isolated by its owner or the network.
A safety-related defect or a failed warning device stops use. Gloves, cleanliness and daylight are not stop conditions.

practicalCriteria: Completes the full walk-round of a supplied platform, and records a planted defect
Checks overhead and ground hazards and records the decision on whether to proceed
Connects the harness and restraint lanyard to the basket before the basket is raised
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Operator authority check against the business register
stopWorkCriteria: A platform with a safety-related defect is tagged out and not used
Any overhead line not cleared under the business plan stops the operation
No operator authority recorded means the platform does not operate
